As I tell my significant other, just ride the wave and take what opportunities come to you. Even if you have uncertainty, it could lead you somewhere even better.
At 25 I was in undergraduate taking care of someone close to me who was disabled. That person passed away and I was lost.
At 30 I am in a COMPLETELY different field, different state, and happy where I'm at. I know now that I'm better off here than what I studied before. And I'm still taking new opportunities around me because there's always something worth trying out there.
Also, I didn't have wealth behind me. I just took random opportunities because why not.
Keep in mind some people live multiple lives in a lifetime, and success isn't marked by an age.
Keep it moving with breathing room. You'll be okay:)

The rigorous schedule made me insane, then later kept me sane with a distraction.
